description: Set up a local LangChain RAG API on the remote: ensure Ollama, pull models, create a venv, write a FastAPI app that indexes ~/rag-docs into an embedded Chroma store, and serve it on 127.0.0.1:8210.

steps.description: Make sure the AI Chat plugin's Ollama is running on 127.0.0.1:11434 (start it if installed). Install the AI Chat plugin first if this reports it missing.
steps.run: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; if command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1; then export OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11434; nohup ollama serve >/tmp/ollama.log 2>&1 & for i in $(seq 1 20); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 1; done; fi; echo "Ollama not reachable on 127.0.0.1:11434 — install/run the AI Chat plugin first (it sets up Ollama with no root)."

steps.description: Pull the chosen chat + embedding models with Ollama (skipped if already present).
steps.check: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; ollama list 2>/dev/null | grep -qF '{{model}}' && ollama list 2>/dev/null | grep -qF '{{embed}}'
steps.run: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; if command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1; then ollama pull {{model}}; ollama pull {{embed}}; else echo "Ollama CLI not found — install the AI Chat plugin first."; fi

steps.description: Create a Python venv and install LangChain + FastAPI + Chroma (no root).
steps.run: set -e; mkdir -p "$HOME/.mobilessh/langchain"; python3 -m venv "$HOME/.mobilessh/langchain/venv"; "$HOME/.mobilessh/langchain/venv/bin/pip" install -U pip; "$HOME/.mobilessh/langchain/venv/bin/pip" install fastapi "uvicorn[standard]" langchain langchain-core langchain-community langchain-ollama langchain-chroma langchain-text-splitters chromadb

steps.description: Write the FastAPI RAG app (app.py) to ~/.mobilessh/langchain.
Start the RAG API bound to loopback 127.0.0.1:8210 and wait for /health.
steps.run: cd "$HOME/.mobilessh/langchain"; export RAG_MODEL="{{model}}" RAG_EMBED="{{embed}}" RAG_DOCS="{{docs}}"; pkill -f "uvicorn app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8210" 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 1; nohup "$HOME/.mobilessh/langchain/venv/bin/uvicorn" app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8210 >/tmp/langchain-rag.log 2>&1 & for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8210/health >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 1; done; echo "RAG API did not become ready; see /tmp/langchain-rag.log" >&2; tail -n 20 /tmp/langchain-rag.log >&2 || true; exit 1

uninstall.description: Remove the RAG venv and Chroma index (your ~/rag-docs files are kept).
